Pickleball

Pickleball is a paddle sport played on a badminton-sized court with a lowered net.

Where to play pickleball in Georgetown

McMaster Athletic Complex

101 W L Walden Dr, Georgetown, TX 78626

  • 6 lined outdoor courts with permanent nets
  • 2 lined courts with no net on the tennis courts (bring your own equipment)
  • Open seven days a week, daylight until dark
  • Courts available on a first come, first served basis
  • Once courts are full, paddle stacking is encouraged
  • Players must provide their own paddles and balls

Georgetown Recreation Center

1003 N Austin Ave, Georgetown, TX 78626

  • 6 lined indoor courts
  • Drop-in play is only available during the designated times, courts cannot be reserved.
  • Courts available on a first come, first served basis.
  • Once the courts are full, paddle stacking is used to rotate courts.
  • It is not necessary to have a partner to play.
  • Paddles are available to borrow, and balls are available for sale at the front desk ($4 each).
  • Pickleball is included in Georgetown Recreation Center memberships. Without a facility membership, purchase of a daily visit ($6 per person) is required.
  • Scheduled days and times of play are subject to change.

Georgetown Recreation Center Pickleball Hours

Tuesday & Thursday: 8 a.m. – noon (4 courts available 9 a.m.-noon)

Wednesday: 6-8:45 p.m. (3 courts)

Sunday: noon-3 p.m. (3 courts)

For information on pickleball at the Georgetown Recreation Center, contact the center.

Georgetown Tennis Center

400 Serenada Dr., Georgetown, Tx 78628

  • 16 lined outdoor courts
  • Drop-in play available during designated times.
  • Courts are also available by reservation. Reservations may be made one week in advance.
  • Reservation time will be limited to two hours and a maximum of four people per court.
  • No more than four people may be part of the reservation. Individuals may not play under more than one reservation per day.
  • Free for members and a $6 drop-in fee for nonmembers.

Georgetown Tennis Center Open Play Pickleball Hours

Monday-Thursday: 6-8 p.m., 4 courts

Friday-Saturday: 6-8 p.m., 6 courts

Sunday: 2:30-5:30 p.m., 6 courts

Pickleball Programs at the Georgetown Tennis Center

Clinics and lessons are listed with resident and nonresident fees.
